          # Manual matrix excludes only; combos with no conf are auto-excluded.
          # sparc64 used to be excluded here (2026-06-30 .. 2026-07-25): the
          # emulated CMD646 PCI-IDE and wm0 NIC intermittently lost interrupts
          # under net+disk DMA, so guests randomly failed to boot. That was a
          # QEMU bug, not a guest one -- the sun4u sabre PCI host bridge
          # overwrites an outstanding IRQ request, so the guest's
          # interrupt-clear is dropped and both devices wedge. netbsd-builder
          # now patches it and publishes the fixed qemu-system-sparc64, which
          # anyvm >= 0.5.3 downloads and forces on Linux x86_64 hosts; the
          # sparc64 confs pin BUILDER_VERSION=2.1.5 / ANYVM_VERSION=0.5.3 so
          # every run gets it. Verified by anyvm's own netbsd.yml testsparc64
          # job (10.0/10.1/11.0 x sshfs,nfs,sys-nfs,scp,rsync -- all green),
          # so sparc64 is CI-tested again and the exclude is gone.
          # NOTE the arm64-runner excludes above still drop sparc64 there on
          # purpose: the patched QEMU tarball is a Linux x86_64 build, so an
          # ubuntu-24.04-arm runner would fall back to stock QEMU and wedge.
